description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractRecipient' within the 'OrangeHRM\Core\Mail' namespace. It specifies two abstract methods for retrieving email address and name, serving as a base for email recipient entities in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: AbstractRecipient
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a base for email recipient entities, requiring implementation of methods for retrieving email address and name.

methods.name: getEmailAddress
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the email address of the recipient.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the full name of the recipient.
